# Aventra Creative

> Aventra Creative is a solo-founder digital agency based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India, building premium websites, SEO strategy, branding, and growth systems for small and mid-sized businesses.

Founded by Sujal Patidar, a full-stack developer, Aventra Creative designs and develops high-performance websites (primarily Next.js) and pairs them with SEO, branding, and digital marketing so client sites rank well and convert visitors into customers. Past work spans hospitality, solar/B2B, events photography, and e-commerce/agriculture clients.

## Company

- Name: Aventra Creative
- Founder: Sujal Patidar (Founder & Full-Stack Developer)
- Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India
